items.title: What it will take to reduce geothermal energy prices
items.summary: The advanced U.S. geothermal industry is heating up for many reasons: skyrocketing electricity demand, looming 2030 renewable energy targets, technical advances and a country abundant with promising geology.

items.title: COP31 Covered podcast: Why does the energy transition need a circular approach?
items.summary: The third episode of edie’s daily COP31 Covered podcast is streaming now, featuring an exclusive interview with Chatham House’s Patrick Schröder on the circular economy.

items.title: WEBINAR NEXT WEEK: How to turn climate risk insights into adaptation action
items.summary: This webinar, held in partnership with SmartResilience on 19 November, will explore why and how leading organisations are moving from simply measuring risk to actively adapting in order to protect their operations, assets and supply chains.

items.title: From to zero-waste action to world leader absences: What happened on 11 November at COP31?
items.summary: One question hung over the first day of the Leaders’ Summit in Antalya: can COP31 deliver when most of the world’s biggest economies have stayed at home?

items.title: UK opens long-awaited consultation on deforestation rules after five-year delay
items.summary: The UK Government has opened a consultation on long-awaited regulations aimed at preventing products linked to illegal deforestation from entering the British market, five years after first promising to introduce the legislation.

items.title: Burnham prepares for COP31 as UK sends mixed signals on clean energy
items.summary: Against a backdrop of mixed clean energy progress for the UK, Prime Minister Andy Burnham is making his COP31 debut today, the only G7 leader to attend this year's summit.

items.title: Pulling back on climate action now is the wrong move at the wrong time
items.summary: The biggest thing I took away from attending a recent global sustainability summit, a room filled with hundreds of CEOs and chief sustainability officers, was uncomfortable: many companies are quietly pulling back on climate action.

items.title: How businesses can align climate goals with energy procurement
items.summary: In edie’s latest cross-sector roundtable, sponsored by SmartestEnergy, UK businesses expressed an appetite to explore CPPAs and boost renewable energy use in their supply chains.

items.title: Analysis: Climate-finance pledges fall 70% as countries meet at COP31
items.summary: The amount of public funding pledged to help developing countries tackle climate change has dropped by more than 70% in 2026, according to Carbon Brief analysis.

items.title: 核電公投首場發表會明登場 廢核平台說明反方理由、呼籲「要領票」
items.summary: 「廢除非核家園」公投將於本月28日與地方選舉同日投票。明（12）日首場電視意見發表會前，全國廢核行動平台今日公布 ，質疑新建核電不切實際，還可能拖慢能源轉型。針對網路上號召反核選民別領公投票，平台提醒，不領票就少一張不同意票，反而可能讓同意票領先。
